android.desc:
Talk to your phone! I can help you save your time and money. Ask me to do things just by talking to your phone. I bring conversational interface, intelligence and many more capabilities to your phone. Some of the additional services I currently provide are: Personalized recommendations, Smart filters, Daily brief, Health planner, Travel planner, Notes Management, Social Updates, Personalized Deal Reports, Personal Radio...

Cluzee in action - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lMsxyuFLNS0

If you need a taxi, just say "Call Taxi". I know you and your location and can order Taxi for you. 

I understand natural language variations. You need not memorize commands. For example, you can ask: 
"What is the weather today?"
"Weather in Miami this weekend"
"Weather forecast for Boston"
"Weather in London"
"How windy is it out there?"
"When is sunrise in San Diego?"

What else can you say?
